ev.q: Return of the Obra Dinn is effectively one large logic puzzle
takes the whodunit's conventions and twists them into kaleidoscopic narratives
Naming the crew is done through small clues, inferences, and logical deduction
allowing the player to fully explore the Obra Dinn
The player is dispatched to the ghost ship to perform an appraisal
Early in the voyage, a seaman and a stowaway are crushed to death by unsecured cargo
